body.message:
Good afternoon,

Thank you for the update.

Please note that your check-out is scheduled for 2nd August. Unfortunately, we are unable to refund the security deposit at the time of check-out.

A check-out inspection will be carried out after your departure. Provided there are no damages to the apartment, the security deposit will be refunded within 7 working days after your departure.

Thank you for your understanding.
